lines.text: David sings that it is good and pleasant when brothers live together in harmony.
Harmony is like fine oil running down Moses' beard over the collar of his robes.
It is like the dew of Sinai falling on the mountains of Zion, where the LORD bestowed life forevermore.
The servants of the LORD who serve by night are told to bless him and lift up their hands to the sanctuary.
May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
